people.name: Daniel
people.line: Prophet in Babylon, known for wisdom and visions

translations.web: Then I, Daniel, looked, and behold, two others stood, one on the river bank on this side, and the other on the river bank on that side.
translations.bsb: Then I, Daniel, looked and saw two others standing there, one on this bank of the river and one on the opposite bank.
translations.kjv: Then I Daniel looked, and, behold, there stood other two, the one on this side of the bank of the river, and the other on that side of the bank of the river.
translations.asv: Then I, Daniel, looked, and, behold, there stood other two, the one on the brink of the river on this side, and the other on the brink of the river on that side.
